[[File:Ice_Images.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Doomed conjuring up Ice images to observe developments in other parts of Kesh]]
'''Ice images''' was a type of [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] developed by [[the Doomed]]&mdash;the descendants of stranded [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Ice images enabled members of the community to witness events occurring in other regions of the planet. This enabled them to monitor the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and helped them to learn about the planet's fauna including [[uvak]]s, a winged reptilian species used as steeds. In [[2974 BBY]], the leader of the Doomed [[Kaliska (S'kytri)|Kaliska]] revealed to the Sith princess [[Takara Hilts]] that this Force ability had allow them to observe developments in the regions ruled by the Tribe.
